item.title: Reflection #1
item.description:
These reflections will be a series of thoughts, ideas, and learnings that I will come back to reflect on in a designated period of time in order to improve my ability to think and reason about the future.

My hope is that my recording my thoughts, feelings, and logic, I will be able to understand why I made the decisions I did with more clarity, and use that information to improve my thinking for the next time I face a similar choice.
